target_customer: Vietnamese parents of K-12 students (grades 6 to 12) paying for after-school tutoring
problem: Offline after-school tutoring in Vietnam is clustered in big cities and run by individual teachers; the company offered live interactive classes online in large or small cohort format.
business_model: Consumer paid live online classes per course and grade

founders.name: Duc Pham
founders.background_notes: YC page: former education private equity investor at TPG Capital investing in K-12 and edtech in Vietnam and Southeast Asia.

founders.name: Tung Tran
previous_startups: A prior Vietnam startup grown to 500 employees across 8 cities (YC description names it as Christina's)
founders.background_notes: e27 (Oct 2022) calls him COO and Pham's brother-in-law. Other outlets give conflicting prior roles (Triip.Me co-founder, Klook Vietnam head), so none is recorded as fact.

competitors.name: Offline tutoring centers
competitors.what: Physical after-school tutoring centers and private teachers, which the CEO called the real competition
competitors.traction_then: Offline tutoring penetration cited at about 50% in Vietnam

competitors.name: Topica Edtech Group
competitors.what: Vietnamese online learning group, live tutoring by native English speakers; also named by the CEO as a shareholder of Marathon, not a direct competitor
competitors.funding_then: US$50M Series D led by Northstar Group (date not confirmed in snippet)

technical_complexity.rationale: Live video classes, scheduling and a learning app are standard engineering; the hard parts were operational: recruiting top teachers and running classes at scale.

defensibility.rationale: Teacher relationships and curriculum content create some stickiness, but other online tutoring platforms could copy live classes.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source shows an incumbent copying or buying Marathon.

market_need_then: Coverage in August 2021 cited a roughly 5 billion dollar offline tutoring market in Vietnam, centers clustered in big cities, and demand for online learning after COVID closures. The company reported 30 percent monthly growth in its first year (e27, 2022).

branding.domain_note: Uses marathon.edu.vn, a Vietnamese education domain, not a .com.

identity.logo: not described in any source found
identity.voice_and_tone: Playful founder title on the YC page, Chief jogger, and the tagline after-school metaverse

branding.brand_signature: Running theme in founder titles (Chief jogger) hints at the marathon name, but no source states the origin

brand_strength.rationale: Regional press covered funding rounds but no source covers the brand itself, merch or community; the word marathon is common and shared by other companies.

outcome_analysis: Marathon raised 1.5 million dollars in August 2021, joined YC Winter 2022 and then reported a seed round of about 5.1 million dollars led by Vulcan Capital in October 2022, a strong funding path for a Vietnamese edtech. YC lists the company as Inactive, yet its website still shows live courses with a 2026 notice and no shutdown, acquisition or layoff report was found, so the cause of the inactive tag is not public. Failure factors are left empty for that reason.
notes: YC status Inactive conflicts with a live company site and no shutdown news; exit.type unknown. The 2022-10 seed of 5.1M comes from a Vietnamese outlet reading an ACRA filing and includes SAFE extensions; e27 only said seven figures. YC page links a headline describing 5.1M led by Vulcan dated Jan 5, 2023. CB Insights total of 8.6M is unverified. Founder prior roles for Tung Tran conflict across outlets. Topica Series D date not confirmed.
